notes.title: Political Economy Update: Factions, Riots, and Power
notes.content: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3503190/AstroCore_Mining/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]With the new Political Economy Update, Astrocore Mining goes beyond survival and resource extraction. As a middle manager in charge of a corporate colony, you face faction conflicts, worker riots, and interstellar diplomacy. [/p][p][/p][p]Choose your ruling style such as democratic or authoritarian, and balance CEO pressure against worker survival. Every policy you enact, every quota you enforce, and every deal you strike determines whether your company rises as a capitalist powerhouse or collapses under chaos.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545968/01c17e82188f645421db72ba6db619e0c1eb8a03.png"][/img][/p][h3]✦ New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Main Frame Building[/b]: The central hub where managers oversee all asteroid operations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Manager Role[/b]: You control the fate of the colony, from strategy to survival.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guards[/b]: Armed units defend against pirate raids. More guards can be recruited to secure the asteroid.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pirate Raids[/b]: Pirates attack, stealing funds and killing anyone in their way.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Air Lock Building[/b]: Entry point for all ships docking at the asteroid.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Worker Riots[/b]: Unpaid workers revolt, spreading chaos across the colony.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hospital Beds[/b]: Provide recovery areas where injured workers can heal.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545968/29063d3e7ffe04d1fd02430e0814bc4a83a2994d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Thanks for playing AstroCore Mining during Automation Fest!
notes.content: [h3]Thanks for playing AstroCore Mining during Automation Fest![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3503190/AstroCore_Mining/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We’re truly impressed by your interest and excitement! 🧡[/p][p][/p][p]Seeing so many of you explore your colony, call in new workers, and cause a little chaos was a joy. Your reactions, feedback, and screenshots keep us going![/p][p][/p][p]We’re already working on new features based on what we saw and trust us, the colony is only going to get more unpredictable.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 If you enjoyed the demo, don’t forget to wishlist the game and share it with fellow space miners![/p][p]See you at the station, commander.[/p][p]– The AstroCore Mining Team[/p]

notes.title: AstroCore Mining Demo is Now Live 🚀
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, explorers![/h3][h3][b]We’re excited to announce[/b] that the [b]AstroCore Mining demo[/b] is now available![/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3816910/AstroCore_Mining_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]🪓 Build and optimize underground bases
⚡ Automate production and manage energy
🚀 Command ships, defend against pirates, and fly entire asteroids to new star systems[/p][p]Can you handle the pressure of deep-space capitalism?[/p][p][/p][h3]What to Expect in Demo:[/h3][list][*][p]🪨 Asteroid Base Building[/p][/*][/list][p]Build underground facilities on a large starter asteroid[/p][p]Dig tunnels, place machines, and design an efficient layout[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]⚙️ Basic Resource Economy[/p][/*][/list][p]Start with limited materials and one central currency[/p][p]Extract and refine core resources to keep operations running[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]👩‍🚀 Colony Survival Preview[/p][/*][/list][p]Colonist population is tied to available beds[/p][p]Manage water and food consumption to survive[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]🛡️ Defense & Recon Systems[/p][/*][/list][p]Purchase basic attack ships[/p][p]Use the Radar Unit for local recon and remote commands[/p][p]Defend against potential threats in your operational zone[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]🚀 Automation & Quotas[/p][/*][/list][p]Assign work schedules and observe AI-driven colony behavior[/p][p]Experience early quota systems (Day / Week / Month) with bonuses or penalties
[/p][p][/p][p]🗨️ 🗣️ We’re all ears, your feedback will help shape the full game![/p][p]Play the demo now and help us make AstroCore Mining even better![/p][p][/p][p]Join our community: [url="https://discord.gg/5acP9AerV2"]https://discord.gg/5acP9AerV2[/url][/p]
